name: Medellín terrace flat
map_intro: Pieced together from your 10 photos, so walls and sizes are estimates. What matters is where the camera stands and which way it looks.

spots.name: Galley pass
spots.about: From the fridge end, the galley leads your eye over the hob, through the pass, to the beams and mountain windows.

spots.name: Two chairs + glass doors
spots.about: Behind the cream armchairs, the glass wall frames the terrace, brick and mountains. The calmest wide in the flat.

spots.name: The terrace
spots.about: Brick, big sky, mountains past the parapet. The signature spot of this place.

spots.name: Sofa window
spots.about: Grid window, tan sofa, mountains. Takes the late sun and throws pane shadows across the floor.

spots.name: Desk nook
spots.about: White desk, red drawers, beams, a window onto the park's running track. Symmetrical from behind the chair.

spots.name: Bed under the beams
spots.about: Pitched pine roof, three leaf paintings and a “Sigue tus sueños” sign. Centre the camera and it frames itself.

routine.title: Morning routine at the glass doors
routine.intro: Doors open, mat down, about 20 minutes. Shoot in this order and it cuts together as one sequence. Best before 8 am.

steps.title: Doors open
steps.camera: Waist height, beside the door frame
steps.how: Slide the middle door all the way open. Let the curtain move and the outside sound come in.

steps.title: Mat unrolls
steps.camera: On the floor, mat rolls toward lens
steps.how: Same spot, just lower. Push the last roll flat with both hands.

steps.title: Settle in
steps.how: Sit facing the terrace. Leave this running for the whole sit; it doubles as a timelapse.

steps.title: Eyes closed
steps.camera: Out on the terrace, looking in
steps.how: Phone on the terrace floor, propped low. You face the camera; the curtains frame you.

steps.title: Breath
steps.camera: Side of the mat, tight on your profile
steps.how: One slow breath in and out. The open door turns into soft brick-and-green blur.

steps.title: Reach up
steps.camera: Low in the corner, 45° to the glass wall
steps.how: Stand, arms overhead. The long glass wall leads the eye to you.

steps.title: Child's pose
steps.how: End in stillness, arms toward the terrace. Hold it and let the curtain move.

shots.title: Desk, back to camera
shots.how: Phone centred behind the chair at seated eye level. Desk lamp on.

shots.title: Hands on the keys
shots.how: Phone low at the side of the desk, window light grazing the keys. Shoot before lunch.

shots.title: Laptop on the terrace
shots.how: Work at the terrace table on a cloudy day. Full sun is too harsh.

shots.title: Desk lamp only
shots.how: After dark, only the desk lamp on, city lights in the window.

shots.title: Warrior at the glass doors
shots.how: Mat in front of the open middle door, phone low on the floor. Hold the pose side-on.
shots.preview: previews/07 Warrior at the glass doors.jpg

shots.title: Terrace flow
shots.how: Mat lengthwise on the brick so the tile lines lead to you. Phone low in the corner.

shots.title: Wake up under the beams
shots.how: Phone on the floor at the foot of the bed, centred. Sit up and stretch.
shots.preview: previews/02 Wake up under the beams.jpg

shots.title: Moka pot at the hob
shots.how: From the fridge end of the galley. Pour at the hob.
shots.preview: previews/09 Moka pot at the hob.jpg

shots.title: Coffee at the parapet
shots.how: From behind the terrace table. Forearms on the brick, mug in hand.

shots.title: Golden hour on the sofa
shots.how: 4:45–5:45 pm. Read in the window-pane shadows.
shots.preview: previews/13 Golden hour on the sofa.jpg

shots.title: Blue hour on the terrace
shots.how: About 6:00–6:15 pm. Wall lamp on, warm mug at the table.
shots.preview: previews/14 Blue hour on the terrace.jpg

shots.title: Reading by the bedside lamp
shots.how: Only the geometric lamp on. Three-quarter angle from the side.
shots.preview: previews/16 Reading by the bedside lamp.jpg

shots.title: Sigue tus sueños
shots.how: Straight on, sitting at the foot of the bed. Plain wall above for text.

shots.title: Sky over the brick
shots.how: You small at the parapet, bottom third. Clouds fill the rest.

shots.title: Empty desk
shots.how: The desk frame with nobody in it. A clean carousel opener.

reset.title: 5-minute reset before filming
items: **Shoes + slippers** by the glass doors go to the wardrobe.
**Suitcase + duffel** by the bar go to the wardrobe too.
**Both standing fans** out of the desk frame.
**Bed**: black sweater off. Beige pillows + one white.
**Galley end**: broom, mop, dustpan and bin out of frame.

light.title: Light in this flat
items: **Sofa windows + desk** get the afternoon sun. Your golden-hour side.
**Mornings** on that side are soft. Best for faces.
**Glass doors**: soft light all afternoon. Great for silhouettes.
**Terrace**: hard shadow in the afternoon. Wait for clouds.
**Ceiling lights** off. Use the lamps after dark.
**Sunset** ≈ 5:50 pm. Blue hour runs about 20 minutes after.

notes.place: Medellín terrace flat (Airbnb), scouted Oct 17, 2026 from 10 iPhone photos
notes.description: Top floor, one long open room. The bed and desk sit under a pitched wooden roof at one end, glass doors open onto a brick terrace at the other, and almost every window shows mountains.
features: Brick terrace with parapet, table + 4 chairs, wall lamp
Three tall sliding glass doors with grey curtains
Galley kitchen with bar + purple stools
Two cream armchairs, tan sofa, round side tables
Bed with three leaf paintings + 'Sigue tus sueños' sign
Geometric bedside lamp, desk lamp; no floor lamps

light.golden_side: Sofa windows + desk get afternoon sun (likely west)
light.glass_doors: No direct sun at 2:30 pm, soft all afternoon
light.terrace: Hard brick-wall shadow in the afternoon
light.sunset: ≈ 5:50 pm mid-October, blue hour ~20 min after
